summary_en: 3,000,000 shares (4.01% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥2.5B upper limit, open-market acquisition on Tokyo Stock Exchange, execution window Aug 4 – Sep 30, 2026. Rationale: enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency; pursue flexible capital policy in response to changing environment.
title_en: Notice Regarding the Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: H.I.S. Co., Ltd. (ticker 9603, TSE Prime) announced on 31 July 2026 that its board of directors has authorized a share buyback program under the Companies Act. The issuer will acquire up to 3,000,000 of its own ordinary shares, representing 4.01% of shares outstanding (computed as 3,000,000 ÷ 74,764,895), for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥2.5 billion. Acquisition will occur via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 4 August 2026 and 30 September 2026. The stated purpose is to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and enable flexible capital allocation in response to evolving market conditions. The company notes that acquisition may be partial or omitted entirely depending on market conditions.
